observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Stage of a theatre or auditorium with a live orchestra seated in the background and a large screen behind them.
observation.dancers: Large mixed group of young men and women (approx. 30 dancers).
observation.formation_and_space: Starts entering from sides in lines, transitions into staggered stage formations, breaks into pairs or small groups moving across the stage, and forms a line across the stage at the end.
observation.posture: Upright and proud torso, knees flexible, weight active on the balls of the feet with intermittent knee drops and floor kneelings.
observation.footwork: Lively stepping patterns including fast running steps, stamping, hops, and occasional knee dips synchronized with the upbeat music.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held high or extended outward, many dancers holding tambourines, shaking them overhead or in front of the chest; some dancers hold drums or small percussion instruments.
observation.hips_and_torso: Controlled torso with subtle hip movements in place during stepping, shifting weight dynamically.
observation.partnering: Independent footwork and formation dancing with brief moments of pairing or moving in unison beside partners.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent transitions from standing to kneeling on one knee, small leaps, and spinning turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional folk costumes: women wear colorful loose trousers or skirts with embroidered vests, headscarves, and aprons; men wear white shirts, dark trousers with wide sashes. Props include tambourines and frame drums held and played by dancers.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact acoustic details of individual foot touches on the floor are masked by music; specific micro-rhythms of footwork cannot be verified due to camera distance.

signature_moments.what: Dancers drop simultaneously to one knee while holding tambourines high in the air and shaking them.
Dancers leap and spin across the stage in circles while playing tambourines.
Group kneels on the floor in unison, swaying torsos side to side with tambourines elevated.
